description: Returns only the personal link (quoteRequestUrl) for one programme and family: the calculator page on goodbyematrix.com with the family already filled in, where the user requests the detailed cost breakdown with the exact amounts by e-mail from the GoodbyeMatrix team. Contact details (first name, last name, e-mail, phone) are optional; only details the user has provided and wants to pass on are used. They prefill the form on that page and are never part of the link; the link works without them. The user checks the details and sends the request personally; the privacy consent is never preselected.

contact.description: Optional. Contact details are used only as the user has provided them in this conversation and wants to pass them on to GoodbyeMatrix; the link works without them. They prefill the request form on the page; they are not part of the link and the user still checks and sends the request personally.

phone.description: With international dialling code, for example +49 151 2345678.

family.description: Everyone who applies together. The first person is the main applicant (role "main"); only the first person has the role "main". Defaults: a partner counts as married and not same-sex unless stated; a child under 18 counts as dependent.

birthplace.description: Optional: country of birth as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, as mentioned by the user.

dependent.description: Dependent on the main applicant (for example a child in education or a parent living in the household).

financially_dependent.description: Financially dependent on the main applicant (relevant for adult children and parents).

married.description: Married to the main applicant (partner) or married themselves (other roles).

nationalities.description: Optional: every citizenship of this person as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (for example ["DE"] or ["RU", "GE"] for dual citizens), as mentioned by the user.

role.description: Relationship to the main applicant: main, partner, child, parent, parent_in_law, grandparent, grandparent_in_law, sibling.

program.description: Programme key: sao_tome (Sao Tome and Principe), vanuatu, dominica, st_lucia (Saint Lucia), st_kitts (St. Kitts and Nevis), grenada, antigua (Antigua and Barbuda), nauru, argentina.

name: request_cost_breakdown_link

contactPrefilled.description: Only when contact was given: true if at least one contact field was accepted and will prefill the form.

ignoredFields.description: Only when contact was given: contact fields that were invalid and dropped.

quoteRequestUrl.description: Link to the calculator page with the family filled in, where the user requests the detailed cost breakdown by e-mail.

title: Get cost breakdown request link
